image_description: A side-profile view of a green minibus with white and blue advertising decals on the side. The vehicle has a boxy shape, a row of passenger windows, and visible wheels. There is text on the side panel that appears to be Japanese or stylized English, but it is blurry and illegible. The background shows a building with a tiled roof.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle exhibits the characteristic high-roof, short-wheelbase proportions of a minibus/coaster-style bus. It is clearly distinct from a full-size city bus.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is visible, and there is a clear sequence of rectangular passenger windows along the side.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle height is consistent with a minibus. A door structure is visible behind the front wheel arch, consistent with a front/mid-entry design.
Vertical seams indicating a sliding door mechanism are visible near the front wheel well.
The front overhang ahead of the windshield indicates an engine compartment, typical for this class of vehicle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a side profile; the rear face of the bus is not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Two wheels are visible. They appear to be standard commercial vehicle wheels, though rim details are obscured by blur/shadows.
The window count (approx 3-4 visible side windows) suggests a capacity consistent with the 4-10 passenger range.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the side of the bus is illegible and structurally nonsensical. Characters blend into each other and lack defined edges, a common AI artifact when rendering small text.
There is significant motion blur or generation blur around the wheels and the bottom edge of the bus, causing a loss of structural definition in the tire treads and rim geometry.
Reflections in the windows are vague and smudged, lacking the sharp specular highlights expected from glass surfaces.
